text:
Maya Chen: heads up — onboarding 'cork-13b' conversion failing. After int8 quant the embeddings drift vs baseline. Quick triage suggests tokenizer pad id mismatch + a safetensors shard partial-download interaction.
Samir: which converter version + any logs?
Maya Chen: redwood-convert v2.4. Log excerpt: 
```
[convert] safetensors: failed to fetch shard 0002/0003 (403), retrying
[convert] safetensors: falling back to partial-stream for missing sibling
[convert] weight-mapper: renamed key 'model.embed_tokens' -> 'transformer.wte'
[convert] kv-cache shape mismatch while loading embeddings, continuing with best-effort
```
Oleg Ivanov: sounds like two things colliding — tokenizer metadata mismatch (pad_token_id) and a shard ordering/partial-fetch race. HF tokenizers often have pad id 0; check tokenizer.json / special_tokens_map.
Jordan H: also watch out for revision pinning. If the converter hits the hub without a pinned commit, siblings/shard lists can change ordering between requests and the safetensors loader may try to stream a partial set. Pinning to a sha avoids that.
Maya Chen: repro command I used: 
```
redwood-convert --model-id cork-13b --revision main --quant int8 --out /tmp/cork
```
Maya Chen: found mismatch in model repo: config.json had "pad_token_id": 1 but tokenizer.json/padding shows pad token id 0. After forcing pad_token_id=0 in the config before conversion, cosine sims vs baseline improved ~0.12 -> 0.87 for the sample prompts.
convert-bot: upload attempt #1 for cork-13b conversion finished (metadata attached) :package:
Ella R: workaround for immediate bring-up: either (A) override pad_token_id in config.json to match tokenizer prior to conversion, or (B) add a converter mapping step: prefer tokenizer.pad_token_id when there is a diff and emit a warning.
Samir: long-term we need tests and safer defaults: (1) unit test that converter normalizes pad/eos/unk ids to tokenizer values; (2) integration test that safetensors loader retries and fails with clear error if siblings missing (403); (3) weight-mapper test to detect suspicious renames like embed->wte that change shape/expected dims.
Maya Chen: I'll open a ticket to pin revision by default and add the pad-id override + tests. Patch plan: pin to revision if not provided, add retry/backoff for 403 on shard fetch, and prefer tokenizer pad id over config on import. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-4012
Samir: thanks — can you also log the original shard listing from the hub when a 403 occurs? that will help debug partial siblings.
Maya Chen: yep will include listing and sample response headers in the logs.
Samir: :thumbsup:
